card.name: Digits inside pre-modern historical years
card.fires_on: A middle digit inside a three- or four-digit year from antiquity to the 1500s, usually in parentheses after a ruler, work or event. Also the name Henry before VIII in a 1531 date entry.

modes.label: Digit in a year
modes.description: A single digit partway through a medieval or early modern year in a date range or parenthesis.

modes.label: Tudor king's name
modes.description: The name Henry in a 1500s history entry about the English king.

card.plain: It fires on the middle digits of old historical years, such as 1532 or 867, in dates for medieval or Renaissance events.
